source_construct: ODS ModelBuildingSummary (Summary of Stepwise Selection), all 24 steps
target_translation: Path and entry/removal rule: batch-1 row 'work.logit_scored_train / model_coefficients / stepwise path' (sas_compat.stepwise_logistic), not re-decided here. File: one row per step 1..24 in step order, columns exactly Step,EffectEntered,EffectRemoved,DF,NumberInModel,ScoreChiSq,WaldChiSq,ProbChiSq. ENTRY step: EffectEntered = full_name[:20], EffectRemoved = empty field, ScoreChiSq = U^2/V of the entered effect at the PREVIOUS step's converged fit (U = z'(y - p); V = z'Wz - v'(X'WX)^-1 v, v = X'Wz, W = p(1-p), X = intercept + current model columns), WaldChiSq = the literal text '_'. REMOVAL step: EffectEntered = empty field, EffectRemoved = full_name[:20], ScoreChiSq = '_', WaldChiSq = b^2/Var(b) of the removed effect at the previous step's fit (Var = diagonal of (X'WX)^-1). DF = '1' (integer text); NumberInModel = effects in the model after the step, intercept not counted (integer text). Chi-squares printed f'{x:.4f}'. ProbChiSq = chi-square(1) upper tail of that step's statistic printed as PVALUE6.4: '<.0001' if p < 0.0001 else f'{p:.4f}'. '_' is how PROC EXPORT writes ODS's special missing ._ in the unused chi-square column: write '_', never '' or '.'. Write all cells as text through sas_compat.write_sas_csv (empty = no quotes)

source_construct: ODS GlobalTests (Testing Global Null Hypothesis: BETA=0) after each of the 24 steps
target_translation: 72 rows (no step 0), columns exactly Step,Test,ChiSq,DF,ProbChiSq; for each step k = 1..24 three rows in this order Test = 'Likelihood Ratio', 'Score', 'Wald'. With q = effects in the model after step k and X = intercept + those q columns: LIKELIHOOD RATIO = -2LL0 - -2LL (step's converged fit; -2LL0 as in the printed_fit_statistics.csv row). SCORE = U0' I0^-1 U0 evaluated at the INTERCEPT-ONLY fit (b0 = logit(ybar), slopes 0), NOT at the step's own fit: U0 = X'(y - ybar), I0 = ybar(1-ybar) X'X. ChiSq printed f'{x:.4f}'; ProbChiSq = chi-square(q) upper tail (scipy.stats.chi2.sf, RULEBOOK §1) printed PVALUE6.4: '<.0001' if p < 0.0001 else f'{p:.4f}'
